Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000887": As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000883": As of 2025-12-23, the pager for the auth gateway rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000823": As of 2025-11-20, the event bus is owned by Team Boreal, which took it over from Team Cinder.  (about: Team Boreal, Team Cinder, event bus)
- memory_id "1000802": Team Boreal holds its planning meeting on Thursdays.  (about: Team Boreal)
- memory_id "1000790": On 2025-11-07, Farah walked Marcus through the reporting service runbook.  (about: Marcus, Farah, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000780" [constraint]: There is a deploy freeze on the billing service from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of peak season.  (about: billing service)
- memory_id "1000770": As of 2025-10-31, Lena is the Team Boreal on-call primary instead of Marcus.  (about: Team Boreal, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000701": As of 2025-09-29, the feature-flags service belongs to Team Boreal, which took it over from Team Cinder.  (about: Team Boreal, Team Cinder, feature-flags service)
- memory_id "1000667": On 2025-09-08, Team Boreal noticed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Boreal, notifier)
- memory_id "1000582": As of 2025-08-01, Lena is back on the Team Boreal on-call rotation.  (about: Team Boreal, Lena)
- memory_id "1000489" [decision]: Team Boreal adopted a weekly dependency update day.  (about: Team Boreal)
- memory_id "1000485": On 2025-06-27, Team Boreal observed that the event bus's request volume halved following the client rollout, noting the event bus is not their service.  (about: Team Boreal, event bus)
- memory_id "1000447": As of 2025-06-16, Team Boreal owns the catalog service, having taken it over from Team Dune.  (about: Team Boreal, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000427": Lena is the release captain for Q1 2026.  (about: Lena)
- memory_id "1000371": On 2025-05-08, Team Boreal flagged that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, noting the catalog service is not their service.  (about: Team Boreal, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000267": As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000225": As of 2025-03-17, the billing service lives with Team Boreal.  (about: Team Boreal, billing service)
- memory_id "1000222": Tomasz Nowak wrote the billing-api handover doc for Marcus on 2025-03-17.  (about: Tomasz Nowak, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000082": Lena takes the first Boreal on-call shift of the year.  (about: Team Boreal, Lena)
- memory_id "1000011": As of January 2025, the Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Team Boreal, Lena, Marcus)
